2607.09183.title: Generative Communications: Overview, Technologies, and Trends
2607.09183.paper_summary: The groundbreaking development of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly boosting the ability to generate content such as images and videos, reshaping communication paradigms. This article introduces generative communications (GenCom), a novel paradigm for 6G networks in which large AI models (LAMs) drive semantic understanding, reasoning, and content generation, embedding these into the communication process. Unlike traditional systems that strictly pursue accurate bit transmission, GenCom enables transmitters to convey only minimal yet sufficient information, while receivers leverage shared generative priors and knowledge bases to synthesize the intended output. Communication is thus redefined as controlled generation rather than data reproduction. We formalize the concept of GenCom, clarify its AI-native and generation-driven properties, and present its core mechanisms. A two-layer GenCom architecture supported by key enabling technologies is proposed, and analysis of four representative application scenarios demonstrates that GenCom offers ultra-efficient transmission, semantic-level robustness, and new network functions. Finally, we outline future research directions, including foundational theory and real-time processing, highlighting a promising pathway toward 6G networks.
2607.09183.paper_summary_zh: 開創性的生成式人工智慧（AI）發展迅速提升了生成圖像和視頻等內容的能力，重塑了通信範式。本文介紹了生成通信（GenCom），這是一種新穎的6G網絡範式，其中大型AI模型（LAMs）驅動語義理解、推理和內容生成，並將這些嵌入通信過程中。與傳統系統嚴格追求準確位元傳輸不同，GenCom使發送者能夠僅傳達最小但足夠的信息，而接收者則利用共享的生成先驗和知識庫來合成預期的輸出。因此，通信被重新定義為受控生成，而非數據重複。我們形式化了GenCom的概念，闡明了其AI原生和生成驅動的特性，並介紹了其核心機制。提出了一種由關鍵啟用技術支持的雙層GenCom架構，並對四個代表性應用場景的分析顯示，GenCom提供了超高效的傳輸、語義層級的穩健性和新的網絡功能。最後，我們概述了未來的研究方向，包括基礎理論和實時處理，突顯了通向6G網絡的有希望的途徑。
